description: Structural assertions for anet demo pr-review output markdown. LLM output is non-deterministic so we assert structure (regex / counts), not verbatim strings. See docs/demos/pr-review-room-proposal.md §测试规格.

good-pr.diff.scenario: README typo fix, single line change

typo-pr.diff.scenario: 1-2 minor style issues (dead helper / over-commented), no severe

cross-file-pr.diff.scenario: SQL injection + N+1 query + hardcoded password + unbounded log buffer + path traversal — should produce many severe issues

note: Mock LLM protocol (issue #30) is required to make these assertions runnable in CI without burning real MiniMax tokens. Until then, run by hand: anet demo pr-review --diff tests/test28-pr-review-room/samples/<file>.diff --suffix <suffix> --out /tmp/out.md, then grep against this file.
